levels.name: Starter
levels.about: Your very first words: things you can see and point at.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.about: Everyday words for people, places, food and plans.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.about: Words for work, travel, shopping and talking about your day.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.about: Words for news, health, opinions and the wider world.

levels.name: Upper-intermediate
levels.about: Words for business, society, science and culture.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.about: Less common words you meet in articles, films and books.

lessons.title: My family photo
lessons.story: Max, look at my [[photo]]. Six [[people]] are in it. This is my [[cousin]], Mila. This is my [[friend]] Lisa. This is [[Miss]] Green, my teacher. The [[baby]] has a funny [[face]]. It is my brother Taras!

lessons.title: Fruit for lunch
lessons.story: It is [[lunch]] time. Anna has [[rice]] and fish. Max wants [[lemonade]]. He likes [[lemon]] and [[lime]] in it. Anna has a yellow [[mango]]. Max has a green [[kiwi]]. Max wants Anna's fruit, too!

lessons.title: A rainy day at home
lessons.story: Taras is on the [[sofa]]. He has a red [[robot]]. Anna has a [[computer]] and a [[radio]]. Look at the [[poster]]! It is a big green [[monster]]! Taras has a [[camera]]. He wants a photo of it!

lessons.title: Sport after class
lessons.story: Max likes [[sport]]. [[Football|football]] is his [[hobby]]. Anna likes [[basketball]]. They want to play after [[class]]. Max has a ball. Oh no, it is a [[baseball]]! This ball is too small!

lessons.title: Tennis and skateboards
lessons.story: Lisa likes [[tennis]]. Ira likes [[badminton]]. Max has a [[hockey]] stick. Anna has a new [[skateboard]]. She likes [[skateboarding]] in the park. Look, Anna can jump! Good job, Anna!

lessons.title: A day at the zoo
lessons.story: The zoo is in a big [[park]]. Look at the [[tiger]]! The [[zebra]] is black and white. The [[crocodile]] has big teeth. Taras, look at the red [[helicopter]]! Dad has ice cream in the [[hall]].

lessons.title: Nice to meet you
lessons.story: Anna is a [[student]] at an English club. Her teacher, [[Mrs.]] Bell, has long red [[hair]]. "Find a [[partner]] and talk about their [[character]], [[please]]." Anna works with Sofia's [[boyfriend]], Leo. A man at the door drops his hat. Leo calls, "Hey, [[mister]], your hat!" Then he smiles: "Sorry, I mean, excuse me, [[sir]]!" The man laughs: "What a [[nice]] boy!"

lessons.title: Lunch at the cafe
lessons.story: Anna and Max are at a small [[cafe]]. There is [[pizza]], [[soup]], and a chicken [[sandwich]]. Max asks for a [[burger]]. "Sorry, we only have a [[hamburger]]," says the waiter. Max laughs: "It is the same thing!" Anna has [[yogurt]] with fruit and honey. Then they go to the juice [[bar]] next door. They buy milk for Mama at the [[supermarket]].

lessons.title: A busy day in town
lessons.story: Today Anna is going [[shopping]] in Kyiv. She rides her [[bicycle]] to the [[bank]]. She gets fifty [[dollars|dollar]] for a new coat. Outside, workers are carrying big concrete [[blocks|block]]. One falls, and Anna falls off her bike. A kind [[cop]] helps her and calls a [[taxi]]. A [[doctor]] checks her foot, and it is fine. Grandpa, an old army [[officer]], laughs: "My brave girl!"

lessons.title: A surprise weekend party
lessons.story: This [[weekend]] is Mama's birthday. Anna has a [[plan]] for a [[surprise]] [[party]]. Taras thinks it is a [[super]] [[idea]]. Dad buys a [[cool]] cake with forty candles. Grandpa is writing a short [[speech]] for Mama. On Saturday, Mama comes home, and everyone sings. It is a [[good]] [[moment]] for Mama. She laughs and kisses Taras.

lessons.title: Festival concert tonight
lessons.story: There is a music [[festival]] in Kyiv tonight. Max and Lisa are at the [[concert]]. Their favorite [[band]] plays songs from its new [[album]]. Lisa has their [[CD]] in her bag. After the show, a [[reporter]] is asking people questions. She asks Lisa, "Do you like the music?" Lisa smiles and says, "Yes, I love it!" Later, Max sees Lisa on TV!

lessons.title: A night at the theater
lessons.story: Anna and Sofia are at the [[theater]] tonight. It is a [[drama]], not an [[opera]]. There is modern [[art]] on the walls. Sofia's favorite [[actor]] plays the [[prince]]. In the play, he loses his love. Sofia is crying, and Anna gives her a tissue. After the show, he signs Sofia's ticket! Now she is very happy.

lessons.title: Our summer trip
lessons.story: Anna and her family are on a summer [[trip]]. They fly to Lviv by [[aeroplane]]. They stay at a small [[hotel]] in the center. Their first [[visit]] is to an old [[palace]]. Then they have a [[picnic]] in a green field. A [[farmer]] comes and gives Taras some apples. Taras says, "Next summer, I want a farm [[camp]]!"

lessons.title: Online at home
lessons.story: Max is making a funny [[video]] for Anna's birthday. He wants to send it by [[email]]. But the [[internet]] is not working at home! Then the [[telephone]] rings. It is Sofia. "Use my Wi-Fi, the [[code]] is 1234," she says. Max sends the big [[file]] at last. Anna loves it and puts it on her [[site]].

lessons.title: Max's job interview
lessons.story: Today Max has a job [[interview]]. He goes to the [[office]] of a small [[business]]. The [[interviewer]] asks, "What [[skills|skill]] do you have?" Max shows her his [[design]] for a new phone. "This is a busy [[period]] for us," she says. "Your [[role]] is to help our team [[leader]]." "Can you start on Monday?" Max smiles and says, "Yes, I can!"

lessons.title: A test at college
lessons.story: Anna studies at a [[college]] in Kyiv. She is taking an English [[course]] there. Today there is a big [[test]]! Anna is a little scared. The first [[activity]] is reading a short text. Next, she writes about her favorite [[type]] of music. It is [[easy]] for Anna! She gets ten out of ten!

lessons.title: The big match
lessons.story: Anna and Max are at the sports [[club]]. Taras has a football [[match]] today. Anna is a big [[fan]] of his team. At the [[start]], Taras is very nervous. Then he kicks the ball and scores a [[goal]]! After the game, the kids play [[volleyball]] together. At home, Dad is watching a boxing [[fight]]. But Taras is sleeping on the sofa.

lessons.title: Breakfast at the café
lessons.story: On Sunday morning, Anna and Max went to a small café. The waiter gave them the [[menu]]. Anna ordered [[toast]] with strawberry [[jam]]. Max wanted a big cheese [[omelet]] and a [[cola]]. It came with tomato [[sauce]] on the side. Then Max saw the cakes and ordered a [[dessert]] too. Anna put a small cookie in her bag as a [[snack]]. At noon, Max was hungry again, so Anna gave him the cookie.

lessons.title: What's for dinner?
lessons.story: On Friday, the family talked about dinner. Taras wanted [[spaghetti]] with meatballs. Mama wanted chicken [[curry]], and Dad wanted a [[steak]]. Grandma said, "I can make [[pasta]] for everyone." But Grandpa had a better idea: a [[barbecue]] in the backyard! Mama put a red [[chili]] in the sauce. Taras tried it and drank three glasses of water. Later he said, "Next time, let's just get [[fast food]]!"

lessons.title: A new sweater
lessons.story: It was cold, so Anna and Lisa went shopping for a [[sweater]]. One shop had a big [[sale]] that week. Anna liked one [[model]], but she wanted it in blue. The [[material]] was soft, and the price was good. Lisa said, "This [[brand]] is great. My jacket is from them." The seller also showed them a new [[product]], a soft winter hat. At the checkout, Anna paid in [[cash]]. But she needed fifty more [[cents|cent]]! Lisa smiled and gave her the coins.

lessons.title: At the barber's
lessons.story: Like every [[teenager]], Max wanted a new look. On Saturday, he went to the [[barber]] near his house. "I want [[blonde]] hair," he said. The barber laughed, "That's a [[crazy]] idea, but okay!" He also gave Max a new [[style]] with short sides. After an hour, he put some [[cream]] on Max's hair. Max looked in the mirror and loved it. At home, Sofia asked, "What happened to your hair?" "It's a [[secret]]," Max said with a smile.

lessons.title: A busy Saturday
lessons.story: On Saturday, the family got ready for Taras's birthday party. Mama hired a [[cleaner]] to help with the house. Grandma put cookies in a big plastic [[container]]. Dad used a [[drill]] to hang a [[dinosaur]] poster. But he hit a [[metal]] pipe, and water came out! Now the family was in big [[trouble]]. Luckily, Mama's helper knew how to fix pipes. In the afternoon, a funny [[clown]] came to the party. Taras said, "I will remember this day [[forever]]!"

lessons.title: At the airport
lessons.story: Anna and her dad were at the airport early. Max texted her, "Have a good trip, and stay in [[contact]]!" First, Anna filled in a form with her name, age, and [[gender]]. At passport [[control]], a woman checked her [[ID]]. Then an [[alarm]] rang loudly when Dad walked through. A [[policeman]] checked his bag and found only keys. On the plane, a friendly [[pilot]] said hello to Anna. He told her many interesting [[details|detail]] about flying. Now Anna wants to fly planes one day!

lessons.title: A city tour
lessons.story: Ira's uncle from Canada came to Kyiv as a [[visitor]]. Anna and Ira took him on a walking [[tour]]. The city [[center]] was full of happy [[tourists|tourist]]. There was a bus [[strike]], so they took the metro. The metro [[escalator]] was very long and deep. Near a church, they saw a beautiful stone [[angel]]. Ira took a [[portrait]] of her uncle next to it. The photo had strong [[contrast]] between the white stone and blue sky. Her uncle said, "This is my favorite photo of the trip!"

lessons.title: A road trip
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna's family went on a road trip to the mountains. Dad took the car out of the [[garage]] early in the morning. Anna and Taras put all their [[stuff]] in the car. Mama packed a small stove and some [[gas]] for cooking. They drove on the [[highway]] for three hours. Taras was tired and in a bad [[mood]]. "Only one more hour, [[max]]," Dad said. In the afternoon, they went [[hiking]] near a beautiful lake. Taras smiled again, and Mama cooked soup on the little stove.

lessons.title: Planning a holiday
lessons.story: Anna's parents wanted a summer holiday, but they had a small [[budget]]. They visited a travel [[agent]] in the center of Kyiv. The agent showed them a [[cruise]] to the Greek islands. "You can pay for it on [[credit]]," she said. Dad said no, because they didn't want any money problems. Taras asked, "Can we go to a different [[continent]], like Africa?" "Maybe next year, if we get a [[chance]]," Mama laughed. Finally, they chose a cheap trip to the sea in Bulgaria. Anna was happy, because she wanted to try [[surfing]] there.

lessons.title: First day at work
lessons.story: On Monday, Sofia started her new job as a bank [[clerk]]. Her [[boss]], Oleh Bondar, met her at the door. "Your first [[task]] is easy: read these papers," he said. At ten, she went to a short [[training]] about the computer system. A young [[manager]] helped her with her emails. Then Sofia wrote all her meetings in her [[calendar]]. In the afternoon, the bank [[director]] came to say hello. "Work hard, and you can get a [[bonus]]," she smiled. Sofia went home tired but very happy.

lessons.title: A business meeting
lessons.story: On Tuesday, Anna's dad had a meeting with a [[businessman]] from Lviv. The man came with his partner, a young [[businesswoman]] named Olena. Their plan was a new city park for one [[million]] dollars. First, everyone had a short [[brainstorm]] about good ideas. Dad said, "A park can have a big [[impact]] on families." Olena agreed: "It's a [[fact]]. Trees have a good [[effect]] on our health." Then they asked an [[expert]] for help with the plan. In the evening, Dad came home in a great mood.

lessons.title: Problems online
lessons.story: Anna needed to print her homework for school. But the [[printer]] at home didn't work. Max said, "You need to update the [[software]]." She searched the [[web]] and found the right [[website]]. But first she had to log in to her [[account]]. She forgot her password, so she made a new one. After twenty minutes, everything worked again! Later, Anna wrote a funny [[post]] about it [[online]]. Max liked it first.

lessons.title: Friday night TV
lessons.story: On Friday night, Anna and Max watched TV at her house. First, they watched a [[quiz]] with funny questions about animals. Then they started a new [[episode]] of their favorite [[show]]. The [[audio]] was very quiet, so Max turned it up. After that, they chose a [[film]] with a high [[rating]] online. A big [[superstar]] played the main role. At the end, the hero was a robot! It was a real [[shock]] for both of them. Max laughed, "Next Friday, I choose!"

lessons.title: A music lesson
lessons.story: On Wednesday, Ira had her first guitar lesson at a music school. Her teacher asked, "What music do you like?" "I love [[rock]], but my brother listens to [[rap]]," Ira said. "The guitar is a good [[instrument]] for both," the teacher said. Then he played a famous [[hip-hop]] [[track]] for her. Ira tried it, but she lost the [[rhythm]] very fast. She said in an angry [[tone]], "I can't do this!" "Don't worry, you have [[talent]]," the teacher answered kindly. At the end of the lesson, Ira played the whole song.

lessons.title: A big sports weekend
lessons.story: Last weekend, Max watched a lot of sports on TV. On Saturday, he watched [[golf]], [[cricket]], and [[rugby]]. On Sunday, he watched the big running [[final]]. A young [[runner]] from Ukraine won a gold [[medal]]! "She's a real [[athlete]]," Max said to Sofia. "She trains every day and has a healthy [[lifestyle]]," Sofia answered. "And you sat on the sofa for two days!" Max laughed and turned off the TV. Next weekend, they are going to go [[snowboarding]] in the mountains together.

lessons.title: My English Essay
lessons.story: This [[semester]], Anna is studying English on a big university [[campus]]. Her teacher asked the class to write a short [[essay]]. First, Anna read a [[text]] by her favorite [[author]]. It was [[fiction]], a story about a girl and her dog. She didn't know some words, so she guessed them from the [[context]]. In her writing, she used the [[adjective]] "brave" many times. Max said, "Try the [[comparative]] too, like 'braver than'!" He also showed her his [[method]] for checking spelling. Anna got a good grade and bought Max a coffee.

lessons.title: Science Class
lessons.story: Today Taras has a science class at school. His teacher draws a line one [[meter]] long on the board. Then she says, "A [[kilometer]] is a thousand of these lines." Next, they weigh apples, and one apple is about two hundred [[grams|gram]]. Five apples make one [[kilogram]], or one [[kilo]]. They also fill a big bottle with one [[liter]] of water. The teacher says everything, even water, is made of tiny [[atoms|atom]]. At home, Taras tells Mama about his day. "I want to be an [[astronaut]] and measure space!"

lessons.title: At the Coffee Shop
lessons.story: On Saturday morning, Anna and Max met at a small [[coffee shop]] near the university. The [[barista]], a friendly young man with glasses, smiled and asked what they wanted. Max ordered a strong [[espresso]] because he had stayed up late studying. Anna wanted a [[latte]] with vanilla [[syrup]], but they had run out of vanilla. So she chose a [[cappuccino]] instead and asked for a warm [[croissant]]. Max couldn't decide between a blueberry [[muffin]] and a slice of [[cheesecake]]. In the end, he took both and shared them with Anna. As they were leaving, they each got a free [[cupcake]] because it was the shop's birthday.

lessons.title: Breakfast at Home
lessons.story: On Monday morning, Anna's kitchen was very busy. Dad was frying [[bacon]] while the old [[toaster]] made loud clicking noises. Taras poured himself a big bowl of [[cornflakes]] and spilled some milk on the table. Mama spread [[margarine]] on her toast and cut an [[avocado]] in half. Anna put a banana, some strawberries and yogurt into the [[blender]] to make a [[smoothie]]. Taras wanted a chocolate [[milkshake]] too, but Mama said it was too early for that. Then Dad filled his [[thermos]] with hot coffee for the long drive to work. Everyone was almost ready when Taras shouted, "Where is my [[lunch box]]?" They found it in the fridge, right where he had left it the night before.

lessons.title: Street Food Festival
lessons.story: Last weekend, Lisa and Ira went to a [[street food]] festival in the park. The air smelled of smoke from a huge [[grill]] in the middle of the square. Ira bought a [[hot dog]] and covered it in [[ketchup]] and mustard. Lisa tried a spicy [[taco]] for the first time and loved it. Then she ordered a [[cheeseburger]] but asked the cook not to add [[mayonnaise]]. It still came with lots of it, so the cook kindly made a new one. Later they shared a big bag of [[popcorn]] and watched a band play. They walked home full and happy, already planning to come back next year.

lessons.title: Pizza Night In
lessons.story: On Friday evening, Anna invited Max and Sofia to her place for a movie night. Everyone was hungry, so they decided to order from the Italian [[pizzeria]] down the street. Max wanted a pizza with extra [[mozzarella]], and Sofia chose a Greek salad with [[feta]]. Anna ordered [[lasagna]] and a big piece of [[tiramisu]] for everyone to share. The app said the [[delivery]] would take forty minutes. While they waited, Anna cut a fresh [[baguette]] and put out some olive oil. When the food finally arrived, an hour late, it was still hot. Sofia laughed, "All that waiting has given me a huge [[appetite]]!"

lessons.title: Cooking a Vegan Dinner
lessons.story: Anna's friend Ira became a [[vegan]] last month, so Anna wanted to cook dinner for her. She found a recipe online and bought every [[ingredient]] at the market. The main dish was pasta with [[broccoli]] and fried [[zucchini]]. The recipe used cream, but Anna used coconut milk as a [[substitute]]. She set a [[timer]] for ten minutes so the pasta wouldn't get too soft. Then she made simple vegetable [[sushi]] with rice, avocado and cucumber. Ira tasted everything and said it was the best dinner she'd had in weeks.

lessons.title: Grandpa's Night Out
lessons.story: For Grandpa's seventieth birthday, the family went to an old [[pub]] in the city center. The friendly [[barman]] knew Grandpa well and gave him a small glass of [[brandy]]. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she ordered apple juice with lots of ice. Next door there was a noisy [[cocktail bar]], and across the street a [[karaoke bar]]. At nine o'clock, a young [[DJ]] started playing old songs from the seventies. Grandpa laughed, "In my day, we called him a [[disc jockey]]!" Then he took Grandma's hand, and they danced like teenagers. Everyone clapped, and Grandpa said it was his best birthday ever.

lessons.title: My new smartphone
lessons.story: Anna got a new [[smartphone]] for her birthday. First, she changed her [[ringtone]] to a quiet song. Then she turned on [[Bluetooth]] and connected her old [[headset]]. On Sunday, she visited her grandparents in the village. There was no [[signal]] in their kitchen, so she couldn't call Max. Grandpa was on the roof, putting up a new TV [[antenna]]. Soon her battery was low, and she had no [[USB]] cable with her. Luckily, Grandma had a [[power bank]] in her bag. "Now my new [[device]] is ready for village life," Anna laughed.

lessons.title: Messages and chat
lessons.story: Anna had a busy evening with her phone. First, she got an [[SMS]] with a code from her bank. Then Max left a [[message]] in the group [[chat]]: "Concert tickets are on sale!" He added a [[link]] to the ticket website. With one [[click]], Anna bought two tickets. She checked her [[inbox]] and found the email with both tickets. Max wrote, "Bring my ticket to school tomorrow, [[plz]]!" Anna sent a quick [[reply]] with a happy [[emoji]].

lessons.title: A video call
lessons.story: Anna wanted to join a summer film course through an [[online service]]. Her laptop was broken, so she went to an [[internet cafe]] near her school. She entered her [[username]] and password on the course website. The site asked for a [[scan]] of her passport, so she uploaded one. Then an error appeared, and she took a [[screenshot]] of it for the help team. The next day, she had a [[video chat]] with the course teacher. Anna said she loved making films with her dad's old [[video camera]]. She wanted to send a short film, but the [[video file]] was too big. The teacher watched it on the course site, though the [[video player]] was slow. "Welcome to the course!" he said with a smile.

lessons.title: A blogger's day
lessons.story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[blogger]] in Kyiv. On her [[blog]], she writes about games and coffee. Every morning, she makes coffee with a paper [[filter]] and takes a [[selfie]] with her cup. Today she was making [[content]] about a new online game. In the game, she found a rare [[item]], a golden sword. She posted a video, and a [[comment]] appeared at once: "Amazing find!" Soon, golden swords became a small [[trend]] among her followers. Later, she even got a friend [[request]] from the game's designer. Sofia was so happy that she made a second cup of coffee.

lessons.title: On TV tonight
lessons.story: On Friday evening, Anna's family looked at the TV guide. Mama wanted to watch a [[talk show]] with a [[celebrity]] chef. Taras wanted a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Dad preferred the scary [[thriller]] on channel two. Anna checked her phone for more [[info]] about the films. "There's a [[fantasy]] movie at nine," she said. "In it, people pray to a golden [[idol]] in a dark forest." Her friend Lisa is in the movie's [[fan club]] and loves it. In the end, the whole family watched it, and even Dad enjoyed it.

lessons.title: Clips and podcasts
lessons.story: Anna and Max went on a road trip with Max's family. Max made a [[playlist]] of their favorite songs for the car. Anna downloaded a [[podcast]] about history for the long road. Max's dad listened to his favorite [[radio show]] on [[online radio]]. On the way, Max filmed a funny [[video clip]] of a goat in the road. He posted it with a short [[tweet]]: "Look who stopped our car!" That evening, Anna found a [[clip]] of the same goat on a news site! Max recorded a thank-you song and sent her the [[audio file]]. Anna made a [[slide show]] of their trip photos for everyone.

lessons.title: Setting up a computer
lessons.story: Anna's dad works in [[IT]], so he helped her set up a new computer. First, he connected a big [[monitor]] with a bright, clear [[display]]. Then the internet stopped working, so Dad restarted the [[modem]]. He also put a [[web camera]] on top for her online classes. Anna put her memory card into the [[slot]] to copy her photos. The card held sixteen [[gigabytes|gigabyte]] of pictures from the summer. Her school project was only one [[megabyte]], and she saved it in PDF [[format]]. But the school website was down because of a problem with the [[server]]. An hour later, it worked again, and Anna sent her project just in time.

lessons.title: Shopping for clothes
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna and Ira went to the [[shopping center]] to buy clothes. Ira loves [[fashion]] and reads about new styles every week. Anna needed something warm for the winter. She tried on a thick wool [[jumper]], but it was too big. Then Ira found a soft [[pullover]] in light brown. "[[Beige|beige]] is perfect for you," she said. Anna also chose a gray [[hoodie]] made of [[cotton]] for the gym. At the last shop, Ira bought a silver [[bracelet]] for her mama. They went home tired but very happy.

lessons.title: Online Shopping Deals
lessons.story: Anna loves [[online shopping]], but she always looks for a good deal. Last night she found a nice jacket on a website for students. First she checked the [[price list]]: the jacket cost fifty dollars. Then Max sent her a [[promo code]] from his favorite store. With the code, she got a twenty percent [[discount]]. Anna did some quick math: fifty [[minus]] ten is forty. It is hard to find a [[balance]] between nice things and saving money. Anna bought the jacket and saved every [[penny]] of the rest for summer.

lessons.title: A Walk Downtown
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna showed Sofia around [[downtown]] Kyiv. They walked along the main [[avenue]] and stopped near a tall [[monument]]. A friendly [[guide]] was telling a group about the city's history. Sofia listened and decided to join a [[city tour]] next weekend. At a [[kiosk]], the girls bought cold water and two ice creams. Behind it, a long wall was covered with bright [[graffiti]]. Then they found a small shop full of old clocks and lamps. Sofia loved an [[antique]], a tiny silver box, but it was too expensive. So she bought a cheap magnet as a [[souvenir]] instead. That evening, she put it on her fridge and smiled.

lessons.title: A Day at the Spa
lessons.story: Anna's mama had a busy month, so Anna planned a special day for her. In the morning, they went to a [[beauty salon]] near their home. A woman did their hair and put on some light [[makeup]]. After lunch, they visited a [[spa center]] with a warm pool. There was also a short [[yoga]] class, and Mama tried it for the first time. She wore soft clothes because [[comfort]] was more important than style today. At home, Dad paid her a [[compliment]]: "You look so relaxed and happy!" Mama laughed and said it was the best gift ever.

lessons.title: Getting Around the City
lessons.story: Anna and Taras were going to visit their grandparents in a village near Kyiv. First, they took the [[metro]] from their home to the city center. Public [[transport]] is cheap, but it was very crowded that morning. Then they changed to a [[trolleybus]] that went to the bus station. From there, a [[minibus]] usually goes to the village. But today it was full, so Dad picked them up in the family [[minivan]]. On the way, they saw a white [[limousine]] with flowers for a wedding. Near the village, Dad turned on the [[GPS]], but it showed a road through a field. In the end, Grandpa met them in his old [[jeep]] and drove them home.

lessons.title: At the Airport
lessons.story: Last summer, Anna flew to Spain with her class for a language course. At home, she checked her [[passport]] three times. She didn't need a [[visa]], but she printed her hotel [[booking]] just in case. At the airport, the class found the right [[terminal]] and went to [[check-in]]. Anna's [[baggage]] was two kilos too heavy, so she put her shoes in her backpack. Near the gate, people with [[business class]] tickets got on the plane first. Through the window, Max pointed at a small private [[jet]]. He said it belonged to a team that jumps with [[parachutes|parachute]] at air shows. Anna laughed and said she was happy in her normal seat.

lessons.title: A Hotel Stay
lessons.story: Lisa and Ira were planning a summer trip to the sea. First, they visited a travel [[bureau]] in the city center. There, a friendly [[travel agent]] showed them many options. A beach [[resort]] was beautiful but much too expensive. A [[motel]] on the highway was cheap, but it was far from the beach. A [[hostel]] was cheaper still, but Ira wanted a quiet room. In the end, they chose a small family hotel near the beach. When they arrived, the woman at [[reception]] gave them the key and the [[Wi-Fi]] password. On the last morning, they ordered [[room service]] as a little treat. Breakfast was so good that they almost missed [[check-out]] at eleven.

lessons.title: A Road Trip
lessons.story: Last summer, Max and his dad went on a [[road trip]] to the mountains. On the second day, the car's [[motor]] started making a strange noise. They drove slowly, well below the speed [[limit]], to the next town. A local [[mechanic]] said he needed a [[minimum]] of three hours to fix it. His garage was small, with space for a [[maximum]] of two cars. While they waited, a friendly [[biker]] stopped and shared his sandwiches with them. Then there was a small [[incident]]: a goat walked into the garage! For five minutes, there was total [[chaos]] as everyone tried to catch it. Finally, the car was ready, and Max called it the best day of the trip.

lessons.title: Backpacking in Australia
lessons.story: After university, Max's sister Sofia went [[backpacking]] in Australia for a month. She stayed in hostels and met many other [[backpackers|backpacker]] from around the world. Sofia learned that [[tourism]] is very important for small towns there. In the north, she joined a two-day [[safari]] to see wild animals. In a forest park, she saw a sleepy [[koala]] high up in a tree. In the desert, she took a funny photo next to a huge [[cactus]]. One day she got lost, but an old [[compass]] helped her find the way back. In her last week, she went on a three-day [[voyage]] along the coast by boat. Back home, she told Max it was the best month of her life.

lessons.title: First day at the office
lessons.story: Anna started a [[part-time]] job at a small travel company in Kyiv. On her first day, the manager's [[assistant]], Ira, showed her around the office. First, Anna signed an important [[document]] for her contract. Then Ira showed her how to send a [[fax]] on a very old machine. At ten, the team met to talk about a project [[deadline]] on Friday. Anna turned on the [[projector]], but the first [[slide]] was upside down! Everyone smiled, and the boss drew the plan on the [[whiteboard]] instead. "Good customer [[service]] is the most important thing here," he said. In the evening, Anna told Max, "I made a mistake, but I love this job!"

lessons.title: The team meeting
lessons.story: On Monday, the [[management]] of Anna's company called a team meeting. The boss wanted new ideas for summer trips, so they started with [[brainstorming]]. At first, the [[process]] was slow, and nobody wanted to speak. Then Anna shared an [[insight]] from her friends: teenagers love cheap weekend trips. "That's an [[aspect]] we always forget," said the boss. But two older workers started a small [[conflict]] about the budget. Anna listened and understood their [[motive]]: they both wanted happy customers. After that, the team made real [[progress]] in just one hour. The boss said Anna's idea had a lot of [[potential]]. Anna went home full of [[enthusiasm]] and told Max everything.

lessons.title: Sofia's new start-up
lessons.story: Max's sister Sofia wants to start a small business that repairs old phones. Last month, she went to a free [[workshop]] for young business people. There she explained her [[concept]]: fix phones instead of throwing them away. "Every phone has metal inside, and metal is a valuable [[resource]]," she said. The teacher called her a real [[innovator]]. A local bank liked the idea and wanted to be her first [[sponsor]]. They made her an [[offer]]: money for one year of rent. That evening, Anna helped her draw a [[logo]], a green phone with a heart. Max thought of the [[slogan]]: "Don't throw it, fix it!" The next day, Sofia put both on her new shop sign.

lessons.title: Mama's big order
lessons.story: Anna's mama works in [[retail]] and has a small clothes shop in Kyiv. Online shopping is having a [[boom]], so her shop is very busy. She decided to buy a new sewing machine from a [[dealer]] in Italy. It cost two thousand [[euros|euro]], so Dad, who works in [[banking]], helped with the payment. Luckily, the family kept some money in [[reserve]] for important things. The machine traveled by ship to the [[port]] of Odesa. Every evening, Mama checked the [[status]] of her order online. Finally, on Friday, a big box arrived at the shop. Taras was happier with the box than with the machine!

lessons.title: Max joins a gym
lessons.story: Max wanted to get stronger, so he joined a [[sport club]] near his home. Before that, he only went [[jogging]] in the park on weekends. On his first visit, a friendly [[fitness instructor]] showed him all the machines. "I'm almost six [[feet|foot]] tall, but I'm very thin," Max said. He looked at two huge men who were doing [[bodybuilding]] in the corner. "Don't worry, [[fitness]] is about health, not big muscles," she laughed. The next week, Sofia joined too because she wanted a personal [[fitness trainer]]. Her old dance [[instructor]] had moved to Lviv, and she missed exercise. Now they go to the club together every Tuesday and Thursday. Max still isn't big, but he can finally run five kilometers!

lessons.title: At the doctor
lessons.story: During exam week, Anna had bad headaches, so she took an [[aspirin]]. It didn't help, so she went to the doctor. She described her [[symptoms|symptom]]: headaches, tiredness, and [[discomfort]] in her eyes when reading. First, the doctor did a quick test for [[COVID]], and it was negative. "It's not a [[virus]]," she said. "I think it's [[stress]] and too much screen time." She sent Anna to an eye [[specialist]] the next day. He said Anna had dry eye [[syndrome]], which is common among students. In the hall, a poster gave a free helpline number for [[suicide]] prevention. Now Anna takes breaks from her phone, and her headaches are gone.

lessons.title: The big match
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna's class played the [[handball]] final against another school. Anna was the [[goalkeeper]], and she was very nervous. In the first half, the [[referee]] gave the other team a penalty. Anna jumped and stopped the ball, and the whole class screamed. Then her [[teammate]] Ira scored two goals in five minutes. They won twelve to ten and became the school [[champions|champion]]! Each player got a small gold medal as a [[prize]]. After the match, Lisa had a [[karate]] competition in the same gym. She is small, but she is a real [[fighter]], and she won too. That evening, the friends celebrated their [[triumph]] with pizza.

lessons.title: Fun by the ocean
lessons.story: In August, Anna's family went on vacation to a small town by the [[ocean]]. There was always a light [[breeze]], so on the first day Dad and Anna tried [[windsurfing]]. They fell into the water many times, but they laughed a lot. On Tuesday, Anna went [[diving]] with a friendly local [[diver]]. He showed her a beautiful coral [[reef]] full of colorful fish. Mama preferred to stay on the beach under a high [[cliff]] and read. On the last day, the whole family went [[rafting]] on a river near the town. Taras was scared at first, but in the end he wanted to go again. "Next summer, we're coming back," Dad promised.

lessons.title: A sports weekend
lessons.story: Max is a real winter sports [[enthusiast]], so he planned a weekend in the mountains. On Saturday morning, he rented a [[snowboard]] and bought a two-day [[ski pass]]. Anna doesn't like fast sports, so she walked up a forest [[trail]] with Sofia. By lunch, Max had fallen in the snow at least ten times. In the evening, the friends went [[bowling]] at the hotel, and Anna won easily. On Sunday it snowed too much, so they stayed inside. They played [[ping-pong]] in the basement all afternoon. "Next winter," Max laughed, "I'm taking lessons first!"

lessons.title: Dating and respect
lessons.story: Anna has a [[crush]] on a boy from her English class, but she is too shy. She asked Ira for some advice about [[dating]]. "Be yourself, and find someone who treats you with [[respect]]," Ira said. That made [[sense]] to Anna. The next day, a doctor gave a health talk at school about love and [[sex]]. She also said that everyone deserves kindness, and that it is okay to be [[gay]]. After class, the boy from English held the door open for Anna. "You're a real [[gentleman]]," she said with a smile. "Only for a real [[lady]]," he answered, and they both laughed. Then they walked home together for the first time.

lessons.title: A babysitter for my sis
lessons.story: On Saturday night, Max's parents asked Anna to be a [[babysitter]] for little Sofia. Max stayed home too, but he only wanted to play video games. "Hey [[sis]], what do you want to do?" Anna asked Sofia with a smile. Sofia wanted to visit the [[pet shop]] near their house. There she fell in love with a [[mini]] rabbit, but they couldn't buy it. At home, Sofia drew a white [[pony]] with a long pink tail. Then she covered the whole picture with colorful [[stickers|sticker]]. When her parents came back, Sofia was asleep with the picture in her hands.

lessons.title: Family game night
lessons.story: On Friday, Anna's family had a game night at her grandparents' house. Taras is a serious [[gamer]], but Grandma said, "No phones tonight!" First, Grandpa and Dad tried to finish the [[crossword]] in the newspaper. Mama and Anna started a big [[puzzle]] with a picture of Kyiv. Then Grandma brought out her old [[bingo]] cards, and Taras won twice. Later, Taras built a long line on the floor and pushed the first [[domino]]. Mama read everyone's [[horoscope]] from a magazine, and Grandpa laughed at his. At the end, Grandma opened the [[photo album]] and showed them Dad as a little boy. "This is better than my phone!" Taras said.

lessons.title: At a rock festival
lessons.story: Last summer, Max and Lisa camped for three days at a [[rock festival]]. Lisa had never been to a [[live concert]] before, so she was very excited. On the first night, they saw a [[rock band]] from Kharkiv on the main stage. The [[drummer]] counted to four, and the whole crowd started jumping. Then the [[guitarist]] played a solo that lasted almost five minutes. On the second day, a young [[rapper]] surprised everyone by joining the band. Max called his dad, who loves old [[rock and roll]], and held up his phone. Now Max and Lisa are saving money for a [[rock concert]] in Kyiv.

lessons.title: A summer jazz festival
lessons.story: Every summer, Anna's family goes to the [[jazz festival]] in the park. Dad has loved [[jazz]] since he was a teenager. The bands come on stage at thirty-minute [[intervals|interval]]. This year, the first musician played the [[saxophone]] so beautifully that Mama closed her eyes. Then an old [[pianist]] played a slow [[waltz]], and Grandpa danced with Grandma. Taras liked a children's band best, because one girl played the [[xylophone]]. Next came a group that mixed [[folk]] songs with modern sounds. Between two bands, Anna met a music [[producer]] who was buying coffee. Before he could say a word, Taras ran up and said, "I can play the drums!"

lessons.title: Old films and poems
lessons.story: Anna's grandpa found an old [[disc]] in a box and put it into the DVD player. It was a film about a young [[poet]] from the [[era]] of black-and-white TV. Grandpa said that a [[critic]] once called his poems "too funny." But Grandpa has always loved their gentle [[humor]]. His favorite poem was about a [[phoenix]] that rises from its own ashes. Luckily, he still had all the poems on an old computer [[disk]]. Anna's mama, who works as a [[designer]], decided to make a small book of them. On Grandpa's birthday, she gave him the book with a bright red bird on the cover.

lessons.title: English grammar class
lessons.story: In English class on Monday, Anna's teacher started with word building. First, she explained that the [[prefix]] "un" in "unhappy" means "not." Then the class added the [[suffix]] "-ness" to "kind" and made "kindness." Max had to find an [[antonym]] for "hot," and he quickly said "cold." Next, they learned that "to swim" is an [[infinitive]]. In her short letter, Ira forgot to put a [[comma]] after "Dear Lisa." The teacher also reminded everyone that B is a [[consonant]] and A is a vowel. Then Anna and Max practiced a short [[dialogue]] about ordering food in a café. Max tried to speak with a British [[accent]], and the whole class laughed. For homework, they had to do exercise six in their [[workbook]].

lessons.title: At the university
lessons.story: Anna studies at a technical [[institute]] in Kyiv. On Monday, her [[professor]] talked about the new [[curriculum]] for next year. Students can also take an [[online course]] in English from home. Max wants to get a [[grant]] to study in Canada next summer. He needs a good [[argument]] for why he should get it. Anna found some great facts in an old [[encyclopedia]] at the library. She wrote the main ideas on the board with a green [[marker]]. Max read them and smiled. "Now my letter is ready!" he said.

lessons.title: Measuring things
lessons.story: Anna and her dad are making a round table for the garden. "The [[diameter]] should be one hundred and twenty [[centimeters|centimeter]]," Dad says. To find the area, Anna needs the [[formula]] for a circle. Taras brings her an old [[calculator]], but it doesn't work. So she uses an [[online calculator]] on her phone. Then Dad drives to the store to buy some paint. One [[gallon]] of paint is enough for the whole table. In the evening, the family eats dinner at their new table.

lessons.title: A day at the zoo
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna took her little brother Taras to the city zoo. First, they watched a big [[gorilla]] eating leaves in the shade. Next, they saw a black and white [[panda]] sleeping in a tree. Taras loved the pink [[flamingo]] standing on one leg in the water. A sign said the zoo copies each animal's natural [[habitat]]. In the farm area, a gray [[mule]] was carrying bags of food. Suddenly, a [[raccoon]] ran across the path with a stolen sandwich! "What a clever little [[organism]]," Anna laughed. Taras said the raccoon was his favorite animal of the day.

lessons.title: Summer on the farm
lessons.story: In July, Anna and Taras spent two weeks at their grandparents' farm. Every morning, Grandpa drove his old [[tractor]] across the field. Taras wore a big hat and called himself a [[cowboy]]. Bees flew from flower to flower, collecting [[nectar]] for honey. In the afternoon, the kids took a small boat along the [[canal]] near the village. Their clothes got very dirty, so Grandma washed them on the short [[cycle]]. That evening, everyone ate fresh honey and bread outside. "This farm is a real [[paradise]]," Anna said with a smile.

lessons.title: Our changing climate
lessons.story: Anna's class is doing a project about the [[climate]] in their [[region]]. Anna's grandpa says every [[season]] is hotter and drier than before. Last year, a [[tornado]] even damaged a farm near his village. Lisa explains that cars put a dangerous [[pollutant]] into the air. Trees take in carbon [[dioxide]], so they help keep the air clean. Ira has a simple idea: start a [[recycling]] program at school. For a week, the students collect every [[plastic]] bottle they can find. At the end, they have five full bags and a great project.

lessons.title: In the science lab
lessons.story: In the lab, Anna and Max did a fun [[experiment]] with a strong [[magnet]]. First, they tested every metal [[object]] on the table. Then their teacher showed them a small [[fragment]] of a dark rock. "This [[mineral]] has iron in it, so the magnet likes it," she explained. Next, they watched a video about an [[electron]] moving around an atom. Max asked why we need [[oxygen]] so much. "Your heart is an [[organ]] that needs it every second," the teacher said. "Teamwork is also an important [[element]] of science," she added. "I'm bad at science, so maybe it's in my [[genes|gene]]," Max joked. "No, you just need more practice!" Anna laughed.

lessons.title: Election in town
lessons.story: Anna's town is choosing a new [[mayor]] this month. At school, Max is running for student [[president]], and Anna is his [[vice president]]. One town candidate calls himself a proud [[nationalist]] and gives loud speeches. On Friday, some students held a small [[protest]] against closing the old park. A local [[journalist]] came to ask them questions. Later, a [[columnist]] in the newspaper wrote that the park plan was complete [[nonsense]]. In the end, the town found a [[compromise]]: half of the park will stay. Max and Anna also had a bake sale for a children's [[charity]]. They didn't win the school election, but they were proud of their work.

lessons.title: A detective movie night
lessons.story: On Friday night, Anna and Max watched an old [[detective]] movie at home. In the film, a quiet [[sheriff]] lives in a small town by the sea. One stormy night, a ship sends an [[SOS]] near the town. People think a [[terrorist]] attacked the ship, and the TV news talks about [[terrorism]]. The army even sends a [[tank]] to the town. But the sheriff just asks, "Where is your [[proof]]?" He finds out that the ship's engine simply broke down. At the end, Max noticed the [[copyright]] date on the screen: 1962. "This movie is older than Grandpa!" Anna laughed.

lessons.title: Brunch at the bistro
lessons.story: On Sunday, Anna and Max met Lisa for [[brunch]] at a tiny [[bistro]] near the river. Max ordered a stack of [[pancakes|pancake]] with fresh berries, while Lisa chose [[French toast]] sprinkled with [[cinnamon]]. Anna couldn't decide, so the waiter suggested a latte with homemade [[caramel]]. "Our house coffee is a special [[blend]] from Colombia and Ethiopia," he explained proudly. When the plates arrived, Max realized that his stack looked rather dry. He had completely forgotten to ask for a [[topping]]. Lisa laughed and pushed her little jug of maple syrup across the table. "Sharing is the best part of Sunday," she said.

lessons.title: Street food festival
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna and Max skipped the usual [[drive-through]] and went to the street festival at the old [[food market]] downtown. Dozens of stalls were already busy, and the smell of grilled meat filled the air. Max went straight to a bright orange [[food truck]] and ordered a spicy [[burrito]]. Anna watched the cook warm each [[tortilla]] on a hot pan before folding it carefully. Then they shared a huge plate of [[nachos]] covered in fresh [[guacamole]]. Ira joined them later with a chicken [[kebab]] and a tub of garlic yogurt [[dip]]. "We've eaten nothing but [[junk food]] all day," Anna groaned, holding her stomach. Max just grinned and pointed at the ice cream stand.

lessons.title: Cooking dinner at home
lessons.story: When Anna's parents went out for the evening, Anna promised to cook dinner for Taras and their grandparents. Grandpa asked for mushroom [[risotto]], so she stirred the rice slowly and grated plenty of [[parmesan]] on top. Grandma, who doesn't eat meat, wanted something lighter, so Anna fried [[tofu]] and vegetables in a hot [[wok]]. Taras, of course, refused everything except [[mac and cheese]]. Meanwhile, Anna boiled a bag of spinach [[ravioli]] from the freezer and sliced some [[salami]] and [[pepperoni]] for a quick snack plate. There was even leftover [[roast beef]] from Sunday, which Grandpa happily claimed as well. As a final touch, she shaved a little black [[truffle]], a gift from her aunt, over his mushroom rice. When her parents came home, the kitchen was a mess, but every single plate was empty.

lessons.title: A healthy lunch
lessons.story: Lisa had recently found out that she couldn't eat [[gluten]], so Anna offered to help her plan a healthy lunch for school. They started with a big bowl of [[kale]], tossed with seeds and a [[lite]] lemon [[dressing]]. Instead of bread, Lisa packed a large rice [[cracker]] and a small tub of [[hummus]]. For something sweet, Anna suggested adding some [[citrus]], since it's full of vitamin C. Lisa grabbed a [[mandarin]] from the fruit bowl, and Anna added a [[tangerine]] next to it. "Wait, what's the difference between them?" Lisa asked. Anna shrugged and admitted that she honestly had no idea.

lessons.title: The dessert menu
lessons.story: For Grandma's birthday, the whole family went to a café famous for its desserts. The menu was so long that Taras read it out loud like a story. Dad chose a warm [[pecan]] [[tart]], and Mama ordered a slice of [[red velvet]] with cream cheese frosting. Anna couldn't resist the chocolate [[mousse]], while Grandpa stayed loyal to his favorite rice [[pudding]]. Taras wanted a [[sundae]] covered in sprinkles, with a toasted [[marshmallow]] on top. Grandma studied the menu carefully and asked whether the fruit jelly contained [[gelatin]], because she prefers desserts without it. In the end, she ordered a [[brownie]] with a candle in it. Everyone sang "Happy Birthday" so loudly that the other customers joined in.

lessons.title: A weekend food tour
lessons.story: Last summer, Max and his sister Sofia spent a weekend exploring their city's international neighborhood on a self-guided food tour. They began at a busy bakery, where they split a warm sesame [[bagel]] with plenty of [[cream cheese]]. Next door, a small tea room served a crumbly [[scone]] with strawberry jam, which Sofia declared the best she had ever tasted. By lunchtime, they had found a Korean restaurant and ordered steaming bowls of [[ramen]]. The owner brought them a free side of [[kimchi]], which turned out to be much spicier than Max expected. On the way home, Sofia bought a bag of [[toffee]] for their parents. Unfortunately, by the time they got off the bus, the bag was mysteriously empty.

lessons.title: An anniversary surprise
lessons.story: Anna's parents were celebrating their twentieth anniversary, so Anna helped Dad plan a surprise for Mama. First, he booked a table at a quiet [[wine bar]] by the river, where Mama ordered a glass of [[chardonnay]]. They shared a plate of soft [[brie]] with grapes and crackers. Later, they moved on to a seafood restaurant, where Dad had grilled [[crab]] and Mama tried [[lobster]] for the first time. Meanwhile, Anna, Taras, and their grandparents were secretly decorating the living room. When the couple returned, all their friends jumped out and shouted, "Surprise!" Mama laughed until she cried, because she had no idea a [[cocktail party]] was waiting for her at home.

lessons.title: Breakfast at home
lessons.story: Every Saturday morning, Anna's kitchen turns into a busy little café. Mama always has [[avocado toast]] with a boiled egg, while Dad sticks to [[muesli]] and coffee. Anna prefers crunchy [[granola]] with yogurt and a spoonful of [[chia]] seeds on top. The night before, she also prepared a jar of [[chia pudding]] made with [[soya]] milk for Grandma. Taras, who refuses anything green, gets a colorful [[smoothie bowl]] with bananas and berries. This morning, Mama decided to try something new: a warm bowl of [[quinoa]] with apple [[puree]] and cinnamon. She proudly announced that it was a real [[superfood]]. Taras took one look at it and quietly asked for pancakes instead.

lessons.title: Coffee break at work
lessons.story: At eleven, Anna's team at her part-time office job finally took a [[coffee break]]. Max, who had been up since six, ordered a large [[americano]] and swore it was only his second that morning. Anna was trying to cut down on caffeine, so she asked for a [[decaf]] with oat milk instead. Lisa, who has recently become obsessed with green drinks, chose a [[matcha]] latte. Ira couldn't resist a mango [[bubble tea]] from the new place downstairs. Sofia came back from the gym with a [[protein shake]] and announced that a [[juice bar]] had just opened right next to it. "Trust me," Max said, "the [[smoothie bar]] across the street is much better." They argued about it for so long that Anna's coffee went cold. In the end, Max felt guilty and bought her a fresh [[ice tea]] with lemon, and everyone went back to work laughing.

lessons.title: Lunch at the café
lessons.story: On Friday, Anna and her friends went to the little café near the university, which has a huge lunch menu. Max couldn't decide, so he ended up ordering a [[club sandwich]] with a side of fries. Lisa went for a hot ham and cheese [[panini]], and Ira asked for grilled chicken on [[ciabatta]]. Sofia had never tried [[pastrami]], so she ordered it on rye and immediately called it her new favorite. Anna wanted something lighter and chose a warm [[pita]] filled with [[falafel]] and salad. Halfway through the meal, the waiter brought a [[fish burger]] that nobody had ordered, and it turned out to be for the next table. Ira admitted that she usually brings a homemade [[bento]] to class, but today the menu was too tempting. Max, still hungry, finished with two spicy [[samosas|samosa]] and green chutney. When the bill came, he promised to bring his own lunch next week, though nobody believed him.

lessons.title: Sunday pasta night
lessons.story: Every Sunday, Anna's family has pasta night, and this week it was her turn to cook. She wanted to impress her grandparents, so she decided to make two dishes instead of one. First, she boiled a big pot of [[penne]] and tossed it with homemade basil [[pesto]]. Then she started a slow [[bolognese]], adding a pinch of [[oregano]] just as her grandmother had taught her. Little Taras begged for spaghetti [[carbonara]], but Anna pointed out that they had run out of eggs. Dad, who never follows a recipe, fried some spicy [[chorizo]] and stirred it into the sauce when no one was looking. Mama had bought a pack of potato [[gnocchi]] as a backup, just in case something went wrong. In the end, nothing did, and Grandpa added a spoonful of [[ricotta]] to his plate and declared it the best meal of the month.

lessons.title: Dinner out with friends
lessons.story: For Lisa's birthday, the friends booked a table at a cozy restaurant that mixes European and Asian dishes. Max ordered the beef [[filet]] and asked for it [[medium rare]], which made Ira pull a face. Ira herself went for a classic pork [[schnitzel]] with potato salad. Anna started with crispy [[spring rolls|spring roll]] and a little bowl of [[sweet chili]] sauce for dipping. Sofia chose chicken [[teriyaki]] with rice and said the [[marinade]] was so good that she wanted the recipe. The chef came out to say hello and shared another secret: his lentil soup gets its flavor from smoked [[paprika]] and a spoonful of ground [[coriander]]. Lisa wrote everything down on a napkin, promising to cook it all for her friends next month. Then the waiters brought out a cake with candles, and the whole restaurant sang to her.

lessons.title: Sweets at the market
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna took Taras to the weekend market, promising him one treat if he behaved. The first stall sold hot [[churros]] with chocolate, and Taras's eyes lit up immediately. Next to it, a small Turkish bakery was selling sticky [[baklava]] with honey and pistachios. Anna bought a bag of salted [[cashews|cashew]] for herself, since she never goes anywhere without a snack. Further on, they found an Italian cart with a dozen flavors of [[gelato]] and a bright lemon [[sorbet]]. Taras, of course, wanted everything, and by noon he was chewing pink [[bubble gum]] that a kind seller had given him for free. On the way home, they stopped by their grandparents' house, where Grandma had just baked an apple [[strudel]]. "So much for one treat," Anna laughed, as Taras reached for a second slice.

lessons.title: A foodie's trip
lessons.story: Max's sister Sofia is a real [[foodie]], so when she planned a trip to Spain with Anna, food came first. Before leaving, she spent hours reading a popular [[food blog]] and making a list of places to try. On their first night in Barcelona, they shared small plates of [[tapas]] and watched the street musicians. The next day, they had a huge pan of seafood [[paella]] by the sea. Surprisingly, Sofia's list also included a tiny [[sushi bar]] run by a Japanese family. Anna added far too much [[wasabi]] to her roll and had to drink a whole glass of water. The owner kindly brought her a bowl of warm [[miso]] soup to calm her mouth. On the last morning, they ate a slice of spinach [[quiche]] at a French café near the hotel. Still, when they landed in Kyiv, the first thing they both wanted was Grandma's [[borscht]].

lessons.title: Drinks at the beach bar
lessons.story: On the last evening of their vacation, Anna's family walked down to a small bar right on the beach. Mama ordered a jug of [[sangria]] to share with Dad, who preferred a [[mojito]] with lots of ice. Anna and Taras asked for two alcohol-free [[piña coladas|piña colada]], which came with tiny paper umbrellas. Taras was fascinated by the bartender, who spun a silver [[shaker]] in the air before pouring each drink. For an older couple at the counter, she mixed something stronger, adding a splash of [[vermouth]] to their glasses. When Dad complimented the service, the young woman smiled and said she was actually the [[bar manager]] and simply loved making drinks herself. She also recommended a [[wine tour]] in the hills nearby, and Mama booked it for next summer on the spot. Meanwhile, Taras announced that he wanted to be a bartender when he grew up, as long as he could do the tricks.

lessons.title: Lunch at the mall
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna's family drove to the big new mall outside the city to do their weekly shopping at the [[hypermarket]]. By noon, everyone was starving, but they couldn't agree on where to eat. Dad wanted to try the [[steakhouse]] on the top floor, but Mama said it was too expensive for a quick lunch. Taras begged to go to the [[burger bar]], while Anna suggested the [[salad bar]] near the entrance. In the end, Mama suggested the [[food court]], where everyone could choose something different. However, it was so crowded that they couldn't find a free table, and the [[sandwich bar]] there had a line of thirty people. Luckily, Anna remembered that a new [[food hall]] with local dishes had just opened on the second floor, and it was almost empty. On the way home, they realized they had forgotten the milk and had to stop at the [[minimarket]] on their corner.

lessons.title: A new outfit
lessons.story: Anna had a school party on Friday and needed a new [[outfit]]. She went to the market with Lisa, who has strong opinions about clothes. First, Lisa held up a pair of [[baggy]] jeans made of soft [[denim]]. "Too relaxed for a party," Anna said, laughing. Then she tried a white [[tank top]] under a gray [[cardigan]], but it was made of scratchy [[polyester]]. Next, Lisa found a smart [[blazer]] in [[khaki]], and it fit Anna perfectly. On the way out, Anna also grabbed a light jacket made of [[nylon]] in case it rained. At the party, Max wore his favorite [[beanie]] indoors, and everyone teased him. Anna just smiled, because for once she felt completely comfortable.

lessons.title: Smart shopping deals
lessons.story: Anna wanted new headphones, but she was trying to save money. Earlier that week she had made a [[deposit]] at the bank, so her birthday money was finally on her card. Max, who loves a good deal, offered to help her shop smart. They found a [[low-cost]] online store that offered free returns. Anna had a [[coupon]] for ten percent off, and her aunt had given her a gift [[voucher]] as well. Max did the math: the sale price, [[plus]] delivery, was still under her budget. He even pulled an old American [[dime]] out of his wallet and joked that it was his contribution. Two days later, a [[courier]] knocked on the door with a small box. The headphones sounded amazing, so Anna bought Max an ice cream to say thanks.

lessons.title: At the beauty salon
lessons.story: Sofia was going to a concert on Saturday, so she booked an appointment at a small beauty [[salon]] near her house. Anna came along to keep her company. The makeup artist started with a thin line of black [[eyeliner]] and then added a little [[mascara]]. Sofia wanted her hair to stay in place all night, so the hairdresser used some [[gel]] and a strong hair [[spray]]. When Anna coughed, the hairdresser opened a window and explained that an [[aerosol]] can should never be used near a heater or a flame. Next door, a girl was getting a tiny [[tattoo]] of a star on her wrist. Sofia admired it, but for now she only asked about getting a second ear [[piercing]] next month. When she finally looked in the mirror, she barely recognized herself, in the best possible way.

lessons.title: A luxury jewelry shop
lessons.story: For Mama's birthday, Anna and her dad visited a jewelry shop that looked like pure [[luxury]] inside. The assistant showed them a necklace with a single [[pearl]] and a ring with a deep blue [[sapphire]]. Dad looked at the price tag and quietly asked if they had anything less expensive. The assistant pointed to the [[premium]] collection, which was still beautiful but more affordable. Anna noticed a pair of [[crystal]] earrings that sparkled in the light. However, when she looked closer, she found a tiny [[defect]] on one of them, so the assistant brought a new pair. She wrapped them in a [[deluxe]] gift box with a silk ribbon. On the way home, a man on the street offered Dad a "designer" watch, but Dad laughed and said it was obviously a [[fake]]. Mama loved the earrings so much that she wore them to her birthday dinner that evening.

lessons.title: A student fashion week
lessons.story: Sofia dreams of becoming a [[fashion designer]], so Anna got them tickets to a student [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. On the way, they stopped outside a small [[boutique]] to look at the window. A [[mannequin]] there was wearing a dress made from a bright Ukrainian [[textile]]. Inside the hall, a well-known [[supermodel]] opened the evening in a long green coat. Afterward, Sofia met a [[stylist]] who had been fixing the models' hair at incredible speed. She gave Sofia a [[catalog]] of the collection and some advice: "Draw every day, even when it's hard." On the bus home, Sofia filled three pages of her sketchbook with new ideas.

lessons.title: Shopping for winter clothes
lessons.story: Winter was coming, so Anna and Ira took the bus to the [[outlet center]] outside the city. Ira admits she is a total [[shopaholic]], so Anna had made a strict list. First on the list was a warm [[parka]] with a fur hood, which Anna found at half price. Ira immediately picked up a gray [[zip hoodie]] and a [[crop top]] that she definitely didn't need. Anna wanted new pants and tried on some beige [[chinos]], but the [[slim fit]] felt too tight. She chose a relaxed pair instead, and an [[oversize]] sweater to go with them. The sweater was [[unisex]], so Taras would probably borrow it. At the checkout, the cashier couldn't scan the [[barcode]] on one of Ira's things, and they had to wait ten minutes. Ira took it as a sign and put half of her things back on the shelf.

lessons.title: Street style photos
lessons.story: On Saturday, Max and Anna went out with Lisa's cousin, a [[fashion photographer]] who takes pictures of [[street style]] around Kyiv. Max carried her heavy camera in his [[rucksack]]. The first person she photographed was a skater with a red [[bandana]] tied around his neck. Then a cyclist lifted the [[visor]] of his helmet and smiled for the camera. It was a cold day, and a young man in a knitted [[balaclava]] said it was the warmest thing he owned. A girl in an elegant silk [[hijab]] had matched it with bright yellow sneakers. Her friend proudly showed off her [[nail art]], tiny painted sunflowers on every finger. Last, they met a musician in the park wearing a huge [[sombrero]] and playing guitar. That evening, the cousin posted the photos online, and the musician's picture got the most likes.

lessons.title: Smart home gadgets
lessons.story: Anna's dad loves gadgets, so last month he turned their house into a smart home. Now a [[thermostat]] on the wall controls the heating, and you can change it from a [[touchscreen]] in the kitchen. A motion [[sensor]] in the hallway turns on the lights whenever Taras walks past. Dad also put a smoke [[detector]] in every room, and it once went off when Anna burned toast. On Tuesday evening, everything suddenly went dark because of a [[blackout]] across the neighborhood. Dad's phone showed an [[alert]] from the power company, and the old [[generator]] in the garage started with a loud roar. A quiet [[beep]] told them the [[boiler]] was working again, so at least they had hot water. In the confusion, their cat ran out the open door, but luckily he has a [[microchip]] with Dad's phone number. A neighbor found him an hour later, and Taras decided the cat was the smartest gadget in the house.

lessons.title: A new townhouse
lessons.story: Anna's family has just moved into a new [[townhouse]] on the edge of Kyiv. The [[interior]] still smells of fresh paint, and most of the boxes are still closed. While Dad tightened a loose [[bolt]] on the kitchen door, Mama looked for the [[detergent]] so she could do the first load of laundry. Outside, workers were pouring [[cement]] for the new front steps. That evening the power suddenly went out, and Grandpa proudly brought out his old [[kerosene]] lamp. By its warm light, Dad found the problem on the electrical [[panel]] in the hallway and switched everything back on. Anna, meanwhile, already had a plan for the [[decor]] of her room. She covered one wall with a huge [[collage]] of photos from her school years. "Now it finally feels like home," she said.

lessons.title: A day in the garden
lessons.story: On Saturday, Anna and her grandmother drove to the [[garden center]] on the edge of town. Grandma wanted a [[jasmine]] bush because she loves how it smells on summer evenings. Anna chose a purple [[iris]] for the flower bed by the front door. At the checkout, Taras begged for a funny little [[gnome]] with a red hat, and Grandma couldn't say no. Back home, Grandpa mixed some [[compost]] into the soil before they planted everything. Then Taras turned on the [[sprinkler]] and screamed with joy when it soaked his shoes. Suddenly something green moved under the bushes: it was Max's [[iguana]], which had escaped from his yard next door. Max ran over, laughing, with a bouquet he had just bought from a [[florist]]. "Happy birthday, Grandma," he said, "and sorry about my pet!"

lessons.title: Getting ready in the morning
lessons.story: Anna's family has only one bathroom, so mornings are always a race. At seven, Dad was already inside, using his [[trimmer]] on his beard and humming loudly. When he finally came out, the whole hallway smelled of his [[aftershave]]. Anna had ten minutes for her [[skincare]] routine and a little [[highlighter]] for school photo day. In the kitchen, Mama was making coffee in the [[French press]]. She added [[stevia]] because she is trying to cut down on sugar. Taras grabbed his backpack, and Mama reminded him to take his hand [[sanitizer]]. Then everyone rushed out of the door at the same time. Halfway down the street, Anna realized she had left her keys on the bathroom shelf, but luckily Taras had his.

lessons.title: Moving into a new apartment
lessons.story: Max's sister Sofia finally moved into her own apartment, and Max came over to help. The kitchen had old [[linoleum]], but the living room had real oak [[parquet]] that shone in the sun. They carried in boxes, a sofa and a soft [[pouf]] that Sofia had bought online. Her tall [[ficus]] barely fit through the door, and a few leaves fell off on the stairs. Max put a tiny [[bonsai]], a gift from their grandmother, on the windowsill. Then Sofia spent an hour on the phone with her [[internet provider]], who promised to connect her by Friday. "Perfect timing," she said, "because on Saturday I'm having a [[house party]]." On Saturday, Anna arrived with flowers wrapped in [[cellophane]], and the place already felt like home.

lessons.title: Family news on Sunday
lessons.story: Every Sunday, Anna's family has a video call with her grandparents. This week Taras had the biggest news: he had become a [[boy scout]], and he proudly showed off his new uniform. Grandpa, now a busy [[pensioner]], said he had been a scout too when he was young. Then Dad shared his news: the roof had stopped leaking because he had finally called a [[professional]] instead of fixing it himself. Anna told them about a new girl in her class who comes from a musical [[background]] and plays three instruments. Max was visiting too, and Taras gave him a high five and shouted, "Nice one, [[bro]]!" Anna rolled her eyes, because her only [[sibling]] could be so loud sometimes. "[[Mama|mama]], can we eat now?" she asked, and everyone laughed.

lessons.title: Talking about dating
lessons.story: On Friday, Anna, Lisa and Ira met at their favorite café to talk about dating. Lisa had news: her [[ex]] had texted her again, asking to borrow money. "That's a huge [[red flag]]," Ira said. "He only ever talked about himself, like a real [[narcissist]]." Ira, always the [[optimist]], believed that Lisa's true [[love story]] was still ahead of her. She even pulled out her [[tarot]] cards and checked Lisa's sign in the [[zodiac]]. Anna laughed and said she trusted honest conversations more than the stars. Then Ira shared happy news: her cousin Dan, who is [[queer]], had met someone kind at an [[LGBT]] youth club. Before they left, Lisa asked if her new red dress was too [[sexy]] for the school dance. "No, it's lovely," her friends said, and Lisa smiled and blocked that boy's number for good.

lessons.title: Checking in at the hotel
lessons.story: Anna and her parents arrived at their hotel in London late on a rainy evening. The [[foyer]] was warm and bright, and a [[friendly]] woman at the front desk greeted them with a smile. "Good evening, [[madam]]," she said to Mama. "You booked one room with a [[king-size]] bed and one with a [[queen-size]] bed, right?" Dad nodded, glad that Anna would have her own room. Their rooms were at the end of a long, quiet [[corridor]] on the fifth floor. Anna's phone was almost dead, but her charger didn't fit the British socket. She went back downstairs and asked the [[concierge]], who lent her a power [[adapter]]. He even found a phone [[holder]] for the car Dad had rented for the next day. Anna fell asleep happy, with her phone charging on the nightstand.

lessons.title: A holiday villa
lessons.story: For their summer vacation, Max's family wanted something special. Sofia showed them a [[villa]] by the sea, but it was far too expensive. Max's mom preferred a wooden [[cottage]] near a lake, while Max dreamed of a beach [[bungalow]]. In the end, they found a small house with a [[jacuzzi]] on a sunny [[patio]] and a shady [[veranda]] at the back. Every afternoon, Max read in the [[hammock]] until he fell asleep. On the last day, his mom went to a nearby [[spa]] and had her first real [[massage]]. "Next year," she said, completely relaxed, "we are coming back to exactly the same place."

lessons.title: A long flight
lessons.story: Anna and Max booked a trip to Canada through a small [[tour operator]] in Kyiv. Their flight wasn't [[nonstop]], so they changed planes at a busy European [[hub]]. During the wait, Max wandered around the [[duty-free]] and bought chocolate for his sister Sofia. On the long second flight, a friendly [[steward]] let Anna peek into the [[cockpit]] before takeoff. When they landed, Anna remembered to switch off [[roaming]] so she wouldn't get a huge phone bill. A free [[shuttle]] took them to their hotel, but they both felt terrible [[jet lag]] that evening. The next morning, they flew to a tiny island on an old plane with a noisy [[propeller]], and Max slept the whole way.

lessons.title: Buying a car
lessons.story: Anna's dad finally decided it was time to replace his old [[automobile]], which was older than Anna. On Saturday, the whole family went to a big [[auto]] dealership outside Kyiv. Taras ran straight to a shiny red [[supercar]], but Dad just laughed and shook his head. The salesman suggested a practical [[sedan]] or a strong [[pickup]] for trips to the grandparents' village. Dad asked whether the pickup ran on [[diesel]] and how much fuel it used. Then he took the sedan for a [[test drive]] with Mama in the passenger seat. It had a small [[turbo]], so it felt surprisingly quick on the highway. When Dad pressed the brake [[pedal]] at a red light, the car stopped smoothly. Back at the lot, Mama noticed a tiny scratch on the [[bumper]], and the salesman lowered the price. Dad signed the papers, and Taras named the new car "Rocket."

lessons.title: Biking around the city
lessons.story: Last Sunday, Anna and Lisa went [[biking]] around Kyiv. Lisa rode her heavy [[mountain bike]], while Anna rented an electric [[scooter]] through an app. They started on a wide [[boulevard]] lined with chestnut trees. A delivery driver on a noisy [[moped]] passed them and waved. Near the river, they stopped at a war [[memorial]] and quietly read the names. Then they rode through a long [[tunnel]], where their voices echoed loudly. On the other side, workers were laying fresh [[asphalt]] for a new bike lane. A city [[inspector]] in an orange vest was checking their work. A speed [[radar]] by the road showed Anna's speed: 24 kilometers per hour. "Slow down, racer!" Lisa laughed, and they headed home for ice cream.

lessons.title: Packing a suitcase
lessons.story: Ira was packing for a two-week trip to Portugal, and she couldn't decide what to take. First, she put in her new blue [[bikini]], because the hotel was right by the beach. Her mom reminded her that evenings by the ocean could be chilly, so she added a warm [[fleece]]. Lisa, who was helping, insisted on a light [[poncho]] in case of sudden rain. Ira also folded her grandmother's soft wool [[shawl]] for dinners outside. Then she tried to squeeze in a long [[trench coat]], but the suitcase wouldn't close. "You're going to the beach, not starring in a detective movie," Lisa joked. Ira left the coat at home and put a red [[beret]] on her head instead. "Now I'm ready for Lisbon," she said, and finally zipped the suitcase.

lessons.title: A trip around the world
lessons.story: For a school project, Anna and Max planned an imaginary trip around the world. Their first stop was Norway, where they would cruise along a deep [[fjord]] and visit a museum with a real [[Viking]] ship. From there, they would go to England, where Max insisted on getting lost in a hedge [[labyrinth]]. Next, they would take a [[gondola]] through the canals of Venice. In Istanbul, they wanted to shop for spices at a crowded [[bazaar]]. In San Francisco, they planned to try dumplings in [[Chinatown]]. The trip ended in Australia, where Anna dreamed of feeding a [[kangaroo]]. Max added one last goal: learning to throw a [[boomerang]] that actually comes back. Their teacher loved the presentation and gave them the top grade.

lessons.title: On a cruise liner
lessons.story: Anna's grandparents finally went on the cruise they had been dreaming about for years. Every evening, Grandma sent the family photos from the enormous [[liner]]. On the first night, the ship's cinema showed an old movie about a ship that hits an [[iceberg]], which made Grandpa a little nervous. A few days later, they reached warm waters and went snorkeling over bright [[coral]]. On the way back, a black-and-white [[orca]] jumped out of the water right next to their small boat. At dinner, the chef served grilled [[mackerel]] with lemon and potatoes. Grandpa saved a piece for later, but a hungry [[pelican]] landed on the deck and grabbed it from his plate. Taras watched Grandma's video ten times and laughed every time.

lessons.title: On safari in Africa
lessons.story: Before Max's sister Sofia left for Kenya, her doctor gave her tablets to protect her against [[malaria]]. Her camp was just south of the [[equator]], so it was hot even in the early morning. On her first drive across the [[savanna]], she watched a [[gazelle]] escape from a hungry cheetah. That night, she heard a [[hyena]] laughing somewhere near the tents. The guide told everyone to shake out their boots, and the next morning a [[scorpion]] fell out of Sofia's left one. Later, they spotted a [[cobra]] lying on a warm rock and kept a safe distance. On the last day, the group drove north to a desert [[oasis]] with palm trees and a cool spring. Sofia texted Max: "Best trip ever, but I'll be checking my shoes forever."

lessons.title: Through the Amazon and Andes
lessons.story: Lisa's uncle, a nature photographer, spent a month in South America and told the family about it over dinner. He started his trip in the Andes, where a patient [[llama]] carried his heavy camera bags up the trails. High above the mountains, he photographed a giant [[condor]] gliding on the wind. Then he flew down to the Amazon, deep in the [[tropics]], where the air was hot and wet. His guide cleared a path through the thick jungle with a [[machete]]. On a boat trip, the guide caught a [[piranha]] and showed everyone its razor-sharp teeth. Every morning, they ate fresh [[papaya]] with lime for breakfast. Lisa listened to every story and decided she wanted to become a photographer too.

lessons.title: Dress and Manners Abroad
lessons.story: Anna's university held an international evening, and Lisa insisted they should learn the right [[etiquette]] first. A classmate from India arrived in a bright green [[sari]] and showed them how the long fabric is wrapped. Ira had borrowed a silk [[kimono]] from her aunt, although she kept stepping on its hem. A visiting professor wore a neat blue [[turban]] and patiently answered everyone's questions about it. At the Japanese stand, a short film explained that a [[geisha]] trains for years in music, dance and conversation. Later, at the French café corner, a student dressed as a waiter bowed and said, "[[Madame|madame]], your pancakes are ready." Anna was so surprised that she bowed back, and the whole table laughed. By the end of the night, she decided that good manners mostly mean being curious and kind.

lessons.title: A City Break in Prague
lessons.story: Anna and Max finally booked a [[city break]] in Prague for the long weekend. Their [[tour agent]] found a cheap hotel and sent them a list of every [[must-see]] in the old town. On the first morning, they picked up free maps at the [[info center]] near the main square. Then they jumped on a [[hop-on hop-off]] bus so they could see the whole city before lunch. In the castle museum, Max rented an [[audio guide]] but kept pausing it to take photos. Later they rode the old [[funicular]] up the hill and watched the sunset over the red roofs. Their last evening was a [[food tour]], which turned out to be the best part of the trip. On the train home, Max admitted that he had tried four kinds of dumplings in one night.

lessons.title: The Night Before the Flight
lessons.story: The night before her flight to Lisbon, Anna was packing while she chatted with Max on video. She had already installed an [[eSIM]], so she wouldn't need to buy a local card. Max sent her a [[life hack]]: roll your clothes instead of folding them to save space. Anna packed her new [[action camera]] for the surfing lesson she had booked. She also squeezed in a [[selfie stick]], even though Max teased her about it. "Your phone already has a fifty [[megapixel]] camera," he said. "Just make sure the [[autofocus]] is on this time, unlike last summer." At the airport, the flight was delayed, and Dad used his travel card to get them into the [[business lounge]]. The Wi-Fi there was terrible, so Anna used her phone as a [[hotspot]] to message Max. She sent him a blurry selfie anyway, just to annoy him.

lessons.title: A Week by the Sea
lessons.story: Lisa's family invited Anna to spend a week by the sea in Greece. They stayed at a small family [[guesthouse]] with a view of the harbor.
